title: TopoJSON converter configuration
description: Configures the GeoJSON-to-TopoJSON converter at tools/topojson/convert_layer.py. Pinned per layer so quantization / simplification / -clean flag changes are 1-line JSON edits (no code change). Carries $schema + $schema_version per CLAUDE.md section 11. Introduced 2026-05-31 as part of TODO/20260531-geojson-to-topojson-migration-plan.md P2.1.

x-changelog.description: Initial schema. Fields: default_quantization (positive integer, applied to layers absent from per_layer); simplification (Mapshaper simplification expression, e.g. 'weighted 5%' or 'visvalingam 3%'); per_layer (map of layer name to overrides). Per-layer overrides may set quantization (positive integer), simplification (string), and clean (boolean opt-in for mapshaper -clean; default false). Per plan section 3 (locked 2026-05-31 per Fowler + Gregor red-team).

default_quantization.description: Applied to layers with no per_layer override. Default 100000 (1e5) per OWID precedent.

simplification.description: Mapshaper -simplify expression, e.g. 'weighted 5%'. Applied globally; per_layer override may shadow.

clean.description: Opt-in mapshaper -clean. Default false. Mutates topology; only enable when a specific input justifies it.
